scope.purpose: Stand in for content that is loading with its shape and size, so that the layout does not move when it arrives.
useCases: Lines of text in a card or a list.
exclusions: Composite skeletons (a card skeleton): compositions of Skeletons in examples.
alternatives: Spinner for a short action on existing content.

examples.preview: dist/previews/skeleton.html (npm run build && npm run build:preview skeleton)

contract.scope: Skeleton contract: shape text/block/circle, lines, size (text lines on typography.body.{size}); color.surface.muted pulsing to opacity.muted once per motion.duration.loop, no pulse under reduced motion; hidden from assistive technology.

decisionsTaken: Three shapes (text, block, circle); text lines follow typography.body.{size}: a bar of the font size centered in the line box, so that a skeleton paragraph has the height of the real one.
Painted in color.surface.muted, pulsing to opacity.muted (0.7) once per motion.duration.loop, no pulse under reduced motion.
Radii: radius.indicator for text, radius.container for blocks, radius.full for circles.
Hidden from assistive technology; the busy state belongs to the loading region (integration).
nextAction: Wave 3 implementation gate: review page https://claude.ai/artifact/Aiq2iwyMsxybxfhUqGrGdn; record the approval with source digests (and the pending contract facts for Dialog and Menu, the ButtonGroup context in Button and IconButton), then the Figma parity phase.
implementationNotes: Pulses stay in phase across the page: each pulse animation's startTime is set to 0 (the document timeline origin) when the skeleton mounts.
Text lines use the lh unit for the line box and a bar of 1em: the skeleton paragraph has the height of the real paragraph (checked against real text in the browser test).
